structure: Part 5 of 7, Dashboards and managing notifications. Read in full: e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js (213 lines; 3 describe blocks, 8 tests: overall dashboard (summary cards, /dashboard redirects, the prototype index), category dashboards (live animals with tabs, search, sort and additional filters; germinal products with packages), and the three at-a-glance drill-downs /actions, /changes and /inspection); e2e/manage-notifications.fit.spec.js (195 lines; 5 describe blocks, 7 tests: view a notification per status (submitted action required, submitted, completed, draft), amend a submitted notification (confirm modal, change and save and return, held continue, valid arrival, declaration and resubmit), cancel an amendment, amend and copy guards, copy as new, delete with confirmation and banner); e2e/support/journey.js (270 lines; shared helpers: the /design-release-2.1 mirror mount, url helpers, action-button values, date format, autocomplete and journey steps). Claims cover every route, title, heading, caption, tab, column text, status tag, filter, link target, button, modal, banner and redirect these tests assert, plus gaps where a test title promises more than its assertions prove. From journey.js only what the dashboards and manage-notification flows rely on is claimed (mount, action button values, date format, reference format, create-new redirect); the journey-step helpers belong to other parts' journeys.
